title: Missing constructor parameter

sourceOfTruth.rule: Decompile the installed package and extract the exact constructor signature before editing.

symptoms: There is no argument given that corresponds to the required parameter.
A client subclass base(...) call no longer matches the Core base constructor.
Manual construction or DI registration may fail after the constructor patch.
investigation: Extract the class and missing parameter from the compiler error.
Load the symbol route from Knowledge/index.json if one exists.
Decompile the installed DLL for the base class constructor.
Compare client constructor parameters with the decompiled constructor.
Find DI registrations and direct new(...) call sites for the changed type.
patchRules: Add only the new required constructor parameters.
Pass the parameters to base(...) in the decompiled order.
Update DI registration and direct construction sites in the same patch batch.
Do not add private fields unless existing client code needs them.
antiPatterns: Do not guess parameter order from old diffs.
Do not add dummy nulls or default values for required dependencies.
Do not patch constructor code without the matching DI or call-site update.

successCriteria: The CS7036 family for the symbol reaches zero.
No new missing-service DI errors are introduced for the same constructor family.
